metadata.title: Read Quran & Track Your Memorization
metadata.description: A focused Quran reader for reading, listening, translation, and tafsir.

hero.intro: A quiet place to read, listen, and reflect
hero.eyebrow: Your Quran journey, in one place
hero.title: Read, memorize, and keep going together.
hero.description: A calm reader for your daily Wird, focused memorization practice, and the assignments you prepare for each Quran circle meeting.

tools.title: A clear path for your daily relationship with the Quran.
tools.description: Read at your pace, practise what you memorize, and keep up with your circle without letting the tools become noise.

rhythm.title: Build a daily rhythm that fits your life.
rhythm.description: Choose your portion once, then return each day to a clear starting point and saved progress.

practice.title: New memorization or revision.
practice.description: Choose an exact range, hide the text while reciting, and reveal it only when you need a prompt.

groups.title: A clear plan for every circle meeting.
groups.description: Admins prepare an appropriate range for each learner, listen to their recitation, and decide what is complete or needs more revision.

place.title: Leave and return without losing the thread.
place.description: Read page by page or surah by surah, then continue from exactly where you stopped.

recitation.title: Listen alongside the words.
recitation.description: Play one ayah or keep listening through the surah with your preferred recitation.

meaning.title: Open translation and tafsir without leaving the reader.
meaning.description: Keep the Arabic at the center and bring supporting meaning into view only when needed.

closing.title: Ready when you are.
closing.description: Begin with the first page or choose a surah that is already on your mind.
